title: 2.4 Consequences of Climate Change
description: Warming trends, precipitation shifts, sea level rise, polar change and ecosystem impacts. Easy level.

questions.question: By about how much has average global surface air temperature risen since the late 1800s?
Which areas warm faster than the global average?
options: To moderate potential damages or benefit from opportunities
Higher farmer income and food security with lower emissions
Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter
The landmasses were connected so the reptile could disperse
questions.correctAnswer: Land areas, especially at northern high latitudes in winter

questions.question: What generally happens to sea level as land ice melts and oceans warm?
By about how much did global sea level rise in the twentieth century?
What share of sea level rise came from melting glaciers and ice sheets?
What is a likely consequence of higher sea level for coastal areas?
Which polar region is described as experiencing rapid melting of ice and snow?
In which years did Arctic sea ice reach dramatic record lows?
What may happen to tropical crop yields as the climate warms?
What can elevated carbon dioxide do for some plants?
options: A change in the length of a season only
Act as a fertilizer and speed up growth
questions.correctAnswer: Act as a fertilizer and speed up growth
